sloka: ततः क्रुद्धो दशग्रीवः शरैः काञ्चनभूषणैः।वानराणामनीकेषु चकार कदनं महत् ।। ६.९६.४३ ।।
transliteration: tataḥ kruddho daśagrīvaḥ śaraiḥ kāñcanabhūṣaṇaiḥ।vānarāṇāmanīkeṣu cakāra kadanaṁ mahat ।। 6.96.43 ।।

translations.english: A few were made lifeless, some had their flanks split, some had their heads smashed and few were deprived of their eyes.
